titulo: Ireland contributes EUR 200,000 to strengthen trade opportunities in developing countries
cuerpo: Ireland is contributing EUR 200,000 (approximately CHF 185,000) to the Standards and Trade Development Facility (STDF) in 2026 to strengthen sanitary and phytosanitary capacity in developing and least-developed countries. The contribution will support STDF activities that help countries meet international food safety and animal and plant health standards, as well as facilitate safe and inclusive trade.
